title: Allowable bearing pressure.
officialText:
The allowable bearing pressure for supporting soil and rock at or near the surface shall not
exceed the values specified in Table 1804.1, unless data to substantiate the use of a higher value are developed and contained in the
engineer’s geotechnical report, and the commissioner approves such value. Allowable bearing pressure shall be considered to be the
pressure at the base of a foundation in excess of the stabilized overburden pressure existing at the same level prior to construction
operations.
